div.p: This case-insensitive code system https://hl7.lt/fhir/vitalsigns/CodeSystem/solor-temporary-codesystem defines the following codes:

tr.td: Digital thermometer (physical object)
A device used to measure temperature with digital readout.
Non-contact infrared thermometer (physical object)
A device used to measure temperature via infrared technology that does not come into contact with the skin.
Thermoluminescent diode thermometer (physical object)
A device used to measure temperature that uses a thermoluminescent diode.
Computer aided auscultation (procedure)
A procedure that uses a computer aided device to measure blood pressure.
Measurement of blood pressure using intravascular transducer (procedure)
A device that measures blood pressure intravascularly via a trandsducer.
Wearing street clothes, no shoes (finding)
The subject is wearing clothing but not shoes.
Wearing street clothes with shoes (finding)
The subject is wearing clothing and shoes.
Stadiometer (physical object)
A device used to measure a subject's height.
Capnograph sensor device (physical object)
A device that captures expelled air, either via nasal prongs or CPAP and is used to measure the number of breaths taken per minute.
Respiration strain gauge (physical object)
A device wrapped around a subject chest that measures the number of times a subject's chest expands with each inhalation. This counts the breaths per minute.
Patient lift scale (physical object)
A device used to lift a patient out of or into bed and also has a scale to measure the subject's weight.
Structure of left superficial temporal artery (body structure)
A body structure of the superficial tempral artery on the left side of the body. Currently part of the Solor SNOMED CT extension.
Structure of right superficial temporal artery (body structure)
A body structure of the superficial tempral artery on the right side of the body. Currently part of the Solor SNOMED CT extension.
